name_zh: 乌弗埃/可可/后殖民建设：资源诅咒缓解与出口导向工业化
name_en: Houphouet-Boigny/Cocoa/Post-Colonial Construction: Resource Curse Mitigation & Export-Oriented Industrialization
description_zh: 费利克斯·乌弗埃-博瓦尼 (1905-1993) 科特迪瓦首任总统 (1960-1993)，"非洲建国之父"。核心建国逻辑：可可/咖啡/木材出口导向/法资合作/政治稳定/阿比让奇迹/亚穆苏克罗迁都/大教堂/1990s 多党制/经济危机/1999 政变/内战。体现 M168 资源诅咒缓解——以"出口导向农业+法资深度绑定+政治稳定优先+基建显性化"四位一体，在单一作物依赖/法语非洲/冷战中实现相对繁荣与稳定。
description_en: Felix Houphouet-Boigny (1905-1993) Côte d'Ivoire first President (1960-1993), 'Father of African Nation-Building'. Core nation-building logic: cocoa/coffee/timber export orientation/French capital deep partnership/political stability priority/Abidjan miracle/Yamoussoukro relocation/basilica/1990s multi-party/crisis/1999 coup/civil war. Exemplifies M168 Resource Curse Mitigation—quaternity of 'export-oriented agriculture + deep French capital binding + political stability priority + visible infrastructure' achieving relative prosperity & stability amid single-crop dependency/Francophone Africa/Cold War.
reason_zh: 乌弗埃非单纯建国者，而是"可可外交+法资共生+稳定优先"三位一体务实建国者。以可可/咖啡换法资/技术/市场/安全，以政治稳定换经济增长/外资信心/区域领袖地位。M168 区隔于 M169 后石油转型(沙特)、M171 资源民族主义(伊拉克)、M189 大人制(蒙博图)，核心在于"出口农业+外资共生+稳定优先"的法语非洲务实建国范式。
reason_en: Houphouet-Boigny not mere nation-builder but 'cocoa diplomacy + French capital symbiosis + stability first' trinity pragmatic builder. Traded cocoa/coffee for French capital/tech/markets/security, traded political stability for growth/FDI confidence/regional leadership. M168 distinct from M169 Post-Oil Transition (Saudi), M171 Resource Nationalist (Iraq), M189 Big Man (Mobutu), core: 'export agriculture + foreign capital symbiosis + stability first' Francophone Africa pragmatic nation-building paradigm.
steps_zh: 可可/咖啡出口导向战略：世界第一可可出口国/咖啡第二/法资种植园/合作社/价格稳定基金/出口创汇支撑工业化
法资深度绑定与安全保障：法军驻防/技术援助/法郎区/双边条约/法国核保护伞/双边贸易顺差/法资企业垄断
政治稳定优先与一党制：PDCI 一党制/部落平衡/北方穆斯林/南方基督教/乌弗埃终身总统/反对派温和/政权零政变 33 年
基建显性化与首都迁移：阿比让港/高速公路/水电/亚穆苏克罗大教堂/总统府/和平基金会/显性成就巩固合法性
危机与遗产：1980s 可可价格暴跌/债务/结构调整/1990 多党制/1993 乌弗埃逝世/1999 政变/2002-2011 内战/后乌弗埃时代动荡，务实建国遗产存续性考验
steps_en: Cocoa/coffee export-oriented strategy: world #1 cocoa exporter/#2 coffee/French plantations/cooperatives/price stabilization fund/export earnings fuel industrialization
French capital deep binding & security guarantee: French troops stationed/technical aid/CFA franc zone/bilateral treaties/French nuclear umbrella/bilateral trade surplus/French firms dominant
Political stability priority & one-party rule: PDCI one-party/tribal balance/north Muslim/south Christian/Houphouet-Boigny president for life/moderate opposition/zero coups 33 years
Visible infrastructure & capital relocation: Abidjan port/highways/hydro/Yamoussoukro basilica/presidential palace/peace foundation/visible achievements legitimize rule

Crisis & legacy: 1980s cocoa price crash/debt/structural adjustment/1990 multi-party/1993 Houphouet-Boigny death/1999 coup/2002-2011 civil war/post-Houphouet-Boigny turmoil, pragmatic nation-building legacy sustainability test

expected_en: Quaternity of 'export agriculture + French capital symbiosis + stability first + visible infrastructure' achieves relative prosperity & stability for 33 years amid single-crop dependency/Francophone Africa/Cold War, providing pragmatic nation-building paradigm for Francophone Africa.
